description: This PHP class defines a 'Language' display field used within a reporting system in the OrangeHRM software. It extends the ListableDisplayField base class and specifies methods to return DTO class name, entity aliases, and relevant fields for the report.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Represents a report display field for language-related data within the HRM reporting framework, providing specific configuration for language report fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the full class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in query building related to this display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database field identifiers relevant to this display field.
